FISHING LICENCE · SLOVAKIA

Slovakia fishing licence

Anglers need both a municipal fishing card and a permit for the fishing ground. The inexpensive municipal card alone does not authorise access to a river or lake.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers need the fishing card and the water manager's fishing permit.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 15 are exempt from the municipal card fee, not from the card requirement.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Municipal fishing cardany1 weekEUR 3
Municipal fishing cardany1 monthEUR 5
Municipal fishing cardany1 yearEUR 10

Extra stamps and permits

  • Fishing-ground permit
    For the chosen water, in addition to the municipal fishing card.

Rules visitors should know

  • Obtain both the card and the fishing-ground permit.
  • Return the permit with the completed catch record after use, as instructed by the issuer.

How to buy

Apply for the card at a municipality. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-ground manager or the Slovak Fishing Union.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Slovakia?

Anglers need both a municipal fishing card and a permit for the fishing ground. The inexpensive municipal card alone does not authorise access to a river or lake.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Slovakia?

Municipal fishing card: EUR 3; Municipal fishing card: EUR 5; Municipal fishing card: EUR 10 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Slovakia?

Apply for the card at a municipality. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-ground manager or the Slovak Fishing Union.
